definition: A force is an interaction that can change the motion of a body or produce deformation within a structural system.
physicalMeaning: In structures, forces represent actions that push, pull, or otherwise act on structural members.
engineeringImportance: Understanding force is fundamental to determining how loads travel through a structure and how structural members respond.
practicalImportance: Engineers use forces to establish equilibrium, determine internal actions, size structural members, and check structural safety.
